{"title": "Wikipedia lab: read me", "type": "markdown", "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "### Wikipedia lab

**About 1,800 article intros** from 6 Wikipedia categories, in index `wikipedia_v1` (alias `wikipedia`).

Every panel here is one `_search` with `"size": 0` and an **aggregation**. Click a panel's ⋯ menu → **Inspect** → **Requests** to see the exact query and response.

| Panel | Aggregation |
|---|---|
| Totals | `value_count` + `avg` |
| Top categories | `terms` on `categories` |
| Length buckets | `range` on `length` |
| Longest articles | `terms` on `title.keyword`, ordered by `max(length)` |

Aggregations read **doc values** (column storage), which is why they work on `keyword` and number fields but not on analyzed `text`."}, "aggs": []}
